name: Sync 3
description: Sync's highest-quality lip-sync, handles close-ups, obstructions and extreme angles.

video_url.description: URL of the video to lip-sync.
video_url.title: Video Url

audio_url.description: URL of the audio to sync the lips to.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

sync_mode.description: How a video/audio length mismatch is resolved: bounce plays the video forward then backward until the audio ends, loop restarts it, cut_off uses the shorter input, silence pads the audio through the full video, remap time-stretches the video to the audio.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

temperature.description: How expressive the lip movement is, 0 to 1.
temperature.title: Temperature

active_speaker_detection.description: Lip-sync only the detected active speaker when several faces are present.
active_speaker_detection.title: Active Speaker Detection

occlusion_detection.description: Detect objects covering the mouth; slower.
occlusion_detection.title: Occlusion Detection
